entities.summary: Karla Beatriz Ortiz Oyola is a Peruvian volleyball player who plays as Outside Hitter for the Peru national team. Playing volleyball, Ortiz has represented her country at the 2013 Bolivarian Games, the 2011 Pan American Games and the 2010 FIVB World Championship in Japan.
